title: Five Loaves and Two Fish
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever had to offer something that felt completely insufficient?
reflectionText: Five loaves and two fish — and a crowd that could not be fed by them. Jesus asked the disciples to bring what they had. Not more. Not what they wished for. What is it to be told that the small, insufficient thing in your hands is what the beginning needs — and to find that the rest was never something you were going to produce on your own?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
